name: RefSR-NeRF
definition: Reference-guided super-resolution neural radiation field framework combining NeRF and RefSR-CNN to achieve high-quality new perspective synthesis while balancing memory and speed.
summary: RefSR-NeRF is a reference-guided super-resolution framework that trains a low-resolution NeRF via patch sampling and fuses details from a high-resolution reference image using a CNN to achieve efficient, high-quality novel view synthesis.
